risk_note: RV2 (parsing RV1, app.module.ts RV2). parsing module first build with the parse_input core: up to 3 links or passwords per text in order; platform and category by the link pattern table (platform generated constant, injectable; the real table is empty, no real domain hard-coded); union resolveLink through governance; deriveProductKey; one card per product key (a key counts as seen only after carding or price_unavailable); 30132 when no concrete product is identified (including union-host pages that are not product or promo pages, password switch off, permission-pending stages), 30131 when the platform is unsupported or the key cannot be derived; a union outage on one hit gives that hit 50301 and the others still card; demo delisted maps to 30141; cards only through the catalog active-query entry (entry_source=parse), price_unavailable kept as a typed result; the pasted URL is never the open target; the url parse function exported for B1-06i; ParsingModule wired in app.module (parsing does not import linking). Route POST /v1/inputs/parse is B1-07b. Written by hand.
